purpose: Test whether the unique historical host-climate predictor variance in an insect's actual known-host reference exceeds a noise baseline produced by two disjoint independent subsets of the same insect's modern external climate reference. This is a same-insect-niche *sampling* null, not a random alternative-host or LGM occupancy null.

eligibility.cohort_definition: Pre-existing v0.3 same-50km independently sourced, 10km-thinned data only; no re-selection based on null outcome.

null_design.split_insect_reference: uniform random permutation of n_insect, self first k, non-overlapping surrogate-host next k
null_design.real_host_cloud: uniform draw without replacement k from actual known host external occurrences
null_design.matched_reference_count: all three clouds (actual host, surrogate host, insect-self) have same k, and surrogate/self are disjoint
null_design.climate_current_and_LGM: 4-var CHELSA standardized using source 6343 present climate support; original five path sample points
null_design.observed_and_null_score: fraction of a host-cloud historical delta's variance residual to self climate history, host-cloud current mismatch, self current mismatch and log1p endpoint distance
null_design.other_scores: raw residual variance in standardized climate space, host/pseudo current mismatch, mean delta LGM minus present
null_design.paired_primary: per species median(actual score over 32 draws) - median(surrogate score over 32 draws), aggregated across species with genus-cluster bootstrap of signed paired difference
null_design.positive_prediction: actual known-host historic information fraction exceeds same-niche surrogate median under identical reference counts and self-cloud set
null_design.report: both absolute and relative variance, medians, positive fraction, source counts, null confidence caveats, full 641 status rows
no_tuning: Do not adjust 30/60 thresholds in response to outcomes
Do not subset by positive null difference
Do not conflate correlated 32 draws with independent biological reps
Do not interpret this as random plant host specificity or ancient occupancy

inference_limits: Neither current plant occurrences nor historic climate analogue distance establish past occupied plant ranges or continuous resource corridors
A surrogate made from same-insect reference positions is an observational sampling null, not an ecological host-association shuffle and does not guarantee identical niche in actual plants
Fractions have species-cloud-specific response variance denominators; raw residual variance is a required companion
Original genetic response NOT_EVALUABLE_EMPIRICAL_RESPONSE stays closed; no genotypes, no posthoc confirmatory p-values
Unresolved 12 host taxa and missing native/introduced labels persist. 3 year bins of 300 records are nonrandom samples
Same genus and shared host plants create species dependence; resample genus clusters for descriptive sensitivity, never use 32 within-species draws as independent species
Exploratory null specified after seeing historical predictor v0.3 information values and cannot be a fresh confirmatory hypothesis test
